detail: Public posting records cannot be linked to individual observed hires; all comparisons remain aggregate/ecological.

Only 3 exact role/month cells have both dated postings and known-sex observed hires (minimum 20); cells containing Male outcomes=3, Female outcomes=0 (minimum 5 each). Grouped cross-validation is not estimable.
Phase 5 uses 5 exact role/month posting-hiring overlaps; +1 month has at most three observed pairs and +2 month is deferred.
Observed starts are available April-July 2026. August and September are unavailable, not zero.
Archive capture-only evidence is not treated as an established posting date in temporal comparisons.
213 records have blank/null source sex and remain UNKNOWN; they are excluded from known-sex shares.
No phase establishes that recruiting signals caused observed outcome composition.
No internal Greenhouse matching, recruiter override, applicant-stage, or funnel data are present.
